-- 2021 projects

-- Shrek the Musical
INSERT INTO projectTags (projectId, tagId)
SELECT p.id, t.id FROM projects p CROSS JOIN tags t
WHERE p.title = 'Shrek the Musical' AND t.name IN ('Musical Theatre', '2021', 'Family Musical', 'Fairy Tale', 'Comedy', 'DreamWorks')
ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE projectId = projectId;

-- The Addams Family
INSERT INTO projectTags (projectId, tagId)
SELECT p.id, t.id FROM projects p CROSS JOIN tags t
WHERE p.title = 'The Addams Family' AND t.name IN ('Musical Theatre', '2021', 'Dark Comedy', 'Gothic', 'Family Show', 'Contemporary')
ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE projectId = projectId;

-- Godspell
INSERT INTO projectTags (projectId, tagId)
SELECT p.id, t.id FROM projects p CROSS JOIN tags t
WHERE p.title = 'Godspell' AND t.name IN ('Musical Theatre', '2021', 'Religious Themes', 'Gospel', 'Contemporary', 'Ensemble')
ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE projectId = projectId;
